source: PubMed and PubMed Central via NCBI E-utilities
query_bank: <MOIETY> AND (blood-brain barrier OR cerebrospinal fluid OR brain penetration OR CNS penetration)
<MOIETY> AND ("brain-to-plasma" OR "brain to plasma" OR Kpuu OR "unbound brain" OR "CSF concentration")
scope: 20 active moieties normalised from the shortlist drug labels (salt forms collapsed)
attribution_rule: the drug name, brand name or development code must appear in the sentence itself; unattributed sentences are retained but flagged, because a paper retrieved for one drug routinely discusses others
caveat: sentences are regex-selected and NOT adjudicated; `direction` is a keyword split and is unreliable (a 5-fold brain-to-plasma increase in P-gp knockout mice, i.e. efflux-limited penetration, lands in `supporting`). Every claim carries its PMID, DOI and access level so the finding can be read in context.
